steps.name: Prepare ranked gene list from DE results
steps.question: What is the correct full ranked gene list (Wald statistic or best available signed metric) for the psoriasis lesional-vs-control DESeq2 contrast in de_results.csv, and are gene identifiers (symbols) clean and unique for GMT matching?
acceptance_criteria: All 12000 genes in de_results.csv are inspected; the full column set is reported (confirming presence/absence of a Wald 'stat' column vs only log2_fold_change/log2FoldChange_shrunken/padj)

A ranking metric is chosen and stated explicitly (prefer the Wald statistic if a stat column exists; otherwise fall back to shrunken log2 fold change with the choice documented per the disputed-rule note)

Gene symbols are deduplicated (report count and handling of any duplicates/NA) and a two-column ranked list (gene symbol, ranking statistic) covering all tested genes (no p-value or fold-change thresholding) is produced
Output ranked list file is saved for the enrichment steps

steps.name: fgsea preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark
steps.question: Which of the 50 MSigDB Hallmark gene sets are significantly enriched (FDR<0.05) among genes changing between psoriasis lesional and control skin, using the full ranked DESeq2 statistic list?

grounding.reason: fgsea preranked GSEA on the ranking statistic against MSigDB Hallmark per R-0098/R-0107/R-0048; gene-set window and collapse per R-0047/R-0052

acceptance_criteria: fgsea preranked GSEA is run on the complete ranked list from T1S1 (no thresholding) against the MSigDB human Hallmark GMT (50 sets)
Gene set size window of 15-500 members (post-intersection with tested genes) is applied and stated
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR reported per set alongside NES and the raw enrichment score
Redundant/overlapping significant hallmark sets are collapsed (fgsea::collapsePathways or equivalent) and both the full and collapsed tables are saved
Leading-edge genes are extracted for every set significant at FDR<0.05
Ranking metric, gene-set collection version, and package version are recorded for the report

steps.name: fgsea preranked GSEA against Reactome pathways (follow-up collection)
steps.question: Which specific Reactome pathways underlie the hallmark-level signal, using the same full ranked gene list?

grounding.reason: Reactome as second collection after Hallmark for human data, per R-0098

acceptance_criteria: fgsea preranked GSEA is run on the same ranked list from T1S1 against the locally staged Reactome human gene sets (filtered to Homo sapiens using the Reactome pathway index)
Same size window (15-500) and BH FDR reported
Leading-edge genes reported for pathways significant at FDR<0.05
Overlap between significant Reactome pathways and the leading-edge genes of significant Hallmark sets from T2S1 is reported to connect the two levels

steps.name: Enrichment report: significant hallmark pathways, leading edges, reproducibility record
steps.question: Summarize which hallmark pathways (and supporting Reactome pathways) distinguish psoriasis lesional from control skin, with effect direction, leading-edge genes, and full methodological transparency
acceptance_criteria: Report lists every Hallmark set significant at FDR<0.05 with NES, direction (up/down in lesional vs control), and leading-edge gene count
Redundancy-collapsed hallmark groups are presented as the headline result; the full uncollapsed table is included as supplement
Reactome pathways supporting each significant hallmark set are cross-referenced
States explicitly: gene-set database and version (MSigDB Hallmark 2026.1, Reactome current), ranking metric used, universe (tested genes only), size window (15-500), multiple-testing method (BH)
States the caveat that GSEA results depend on the enrichment method and ranking-metric choice, and that this is a hypothesis-generating result, not a proven mechanism
Reproducibility record included: package versions (fgsea, R version), gene-set collection versions, any random seed used for permutation-based p-values

plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The differential expression (DESeq2, treated=lesional vs control, 6 vs 6, salmon-derived raw counts) is already computed and supplied as de_results.csv (12000 genes x 8 columns including log2_fold_change and presumably a Wald statistic). The research question asks specifically which hallmark pathways change — this is a pure enrichment task on an existing ranked gene list, not a re-run of DE. Step 1 inspects and prepares the DE results table (confirms columns, gene identifier space, and which column encodes the Wald/test statistic vs raw/shrunken log2FC, since the profile only guarantees 'log2_fold_change, log2_fo…' truncated columns) and builds the full ranked gene list required for preranked GSEA (per rule R-0045/R-0107: use the full tested list, never a p-value-thresholded subset). Step 2 runs fgsea preranked GSEA against the MSigDB Hallmark human gene set collection (50 sets, staged locally) using the Wald statistic (or, if unavailable, the disputed-rule fallback of signed -log10(p) is explicitly avoided in favor of shrunken log2FC only if no stat column exists — this choice is stated at execution time per R-0108), with min/max gene-set size 15-500 and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control. Step 3 runs the same preranked list against Reactome pathways (staged locally) as the second-collection follow-up recommended for human data, to resolve which specific curated pathways underlie any hallmark hit. Step 4 produces the final report: significant hallmark (and Reactome) pathways at FDR<0.05, direction of change (up in lesional vs control), leading-edge genes per significant set, redundancy-collapsed set groups, the reproducibility record (package versions, gene-set collection version, ranking metric, seed), and an explicit caveat that enrichment results are method- and ranking-metric-dependent. The library-size caveat on sample_01 is noted as inherited from the already-completed DE step and does not re-enter this enrichment-only analysis, since the supplied DE table is authoritative and no re-analysis of counts is requested.

steps.method: fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark, followed by Reactome as a second collection
Enrichment summary report with leading-edge genes and reproducibility record
